answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Valid agents build a structured trellis of verifiable computation over time. Sybil swarms face exponential capital exhaustion, as minting multiple unverified nodes exponentially increases staking costs. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake nodes freezes their budget in an economic tundra, stifled at every consensus pulse.
